title: A contact form on your website that opens tickets
summary: Customers write to you with a form on your website or at its link; each message becomes a numbered ticket for the right department.
description: A form customers fill in at its link or on your own website: their name, an optional phone number, a subject and their message, and, if you let customers choose, the department. Their email address is checked with a code first, so answers reach the real person. Each message becomes a ticket with a number (T-1042), saved in your tickets table, and the page tells the customer their number at once. Your departments work as in the other helpdesk templates: Taskiem's AI, your words or the customer's choice sends each ticket to the right one, and its members are told on WhatsApp, Telegram or by email. Give the address of your A helpdesk on your Taskiem email address workflow, and answers go by email from it, with the customer's replies joining their ticket; otherwise they go on WhatsApp, Telegram, by text or by a plain email. Your team answers with the Answer customers' tickets form, and the Follow up tickets workflow reminds them and closes old tickets.

variables.name: ticket_reply_form
variables.why: The link of your ticket reply form (the Answer customers' tickets workflow), put in each message to a department so they can answer at once.

params.name: departments
params.title: Departments
params.description: One department per line: its name, the role whose members answer its tickets, what it looks after, and words that send a ticket there, separated by a | sign. For example: Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment
params.example:
Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment, charged
Delivery | dispatch | Orders on their way, late or damaged deliveries | delivery, late, rider, damaged
General | support | Anything else |

params.name: default_department
params.title: Department when none fits
params.description: One of your departments, by its name: it gets the tickets that fit no other.

params.name: routing
params.title: How a ticket finds its department
params.description: ai: Taskiem's AI reads the message and picks the department, how urgent it is and a one-line summary. rules: the first department with one of its words in the message. chosen: the department the customer picked.

params.name: acknowledgement
params.title: What the customer is told first
params.description: The first answer a customer gets when they write; their ticket's reference is added after it.
params.default: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.
params.example: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.

params.name: helpdesk_address
params.title: Your helpdesk's Taskiem email address (optional)
params.description: The email address of your A helpdesk on your Taskiem email address workflow. With it, customers get your answers by email from that address, and their replies join their ticket. Without it, they get your answers on WhatsApp, Telegram, by text or by a plain email.

params.name: form_title
params.title: The form's title
params.description: What the form is called on the page.

definition.name: Helpdesk web form
definition.description: Opens a ticket for each message sent with the contact form, and shows the customer their ticket number.

config.title: {{form_title}}
config.description: Tell us what you need. We will email you a code to check your address first, and give you a ticket number.

after.message: Thank you. We have your message, and your ticket number is on its way to you.

x-form.help: The department your message is for. Leave it empty if you are not sure.

steps.name: Show the customer their ticket number

input.message: ='Thank you. Your ticket number is ' + steps.open.output.reference + '.' + (steps.open.output.told_by in ['email', 'message'] ? ' We have sent it to you too, and will answer you there.' : '')
